name: What are common signs that I need an active roof leak inspection?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that I need an active roof leak inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider an active roof leak inspection if you notice dripping water, water stains on ceilings or walls, bubbling paint, or a musty odor indoors, especially after rain. These are clear indicators of active water penetration. Don't wait for significant damage; early detection can prevent more extensive and costly repairs. Ignoring these signs can lead to structural decay, mold growth, and damage to insulation and electrical systems.
